newsitem.title: USA: Firmer diffs can't stop U.S spot jet fuel slide.
newsitem.headline: Firmer diffs can't stop U.S spot jet fuel slide.

text.p: Firmer cash differentials were not firm enough to keep U.S. spot jet fuel prices from sliding Monday as seller found it easy to incite competitive bidding among the more numerous bidders, traders said.
"There seem to be a lot more buyers than sellers," said one player, noting the firmer diffs were to some extent simply a reaction to the fall in NYMEX heating oil prices.
Still buyers had little to become querulous over, since prices were still anywhere from 0.25 to 0.50 cent lower.
In Houston, prompt airline quality 54-grade traded at 2.25 cent over Apr NYMEX--about 0.75 cent firmer than diffs on Fri.
Also, in New York Harbor prompt low sulphur 55-grade was heard done at 4.25 cents over Apr NYMEX -- up from about 4.00 cents over on Friday.
Traders said 54-grade in NYH was pegged at a 0.25 cent discount to 55-grade.
-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Energy Desk, 1 212 859 1633
